bug_report:
Assigning a CHAR to an INTEGER crashes the compiler
Createdattachment 61489[details]-freport-bug output

Here is the source code:

```
MODULE M;

VAR X: ARRAY[1..5] OF INTEGER;

BEGIN
  X[1] := 'c';
END M.
```

So it just declares an array of integers and assigns a character to an element. Compiling this results in an ICE. Details are in the attachment.
